coverage_notes.observation: Twelve targeted fresh-web queries returned searchable coverage, but no independently verified qualifying U.S. disruption newly reported or taking effect during the bounded observation interval. Results were dominated by old grocery fires, previous storm effects, food access expansions, and SNAP interruption notices from 2025. No fresh event was inferred solely from an index crawl date.

duplicate_screen.method: Fetched the prior heartbeat directly from ops/watch-ledger; compared events' source dates and known historical topics against the new searches.

coverage_notes.limitations: Search indexing and recency filters are imperfect; unindexed hyperlocal notices and delayed online postings may not be visible. Bounded recall does not replace production nationwide ingestion.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, collector mutation, schedule change, or task disabling.
